depends_on: All S321 specifications. S201 Framework v2 Vision §transition_state.
purpose: Define the migration roadmap from Framework v1 to Framework v2 across four operational modes, three phases, and 20-22 sessions. Existing certifications survive the transition — 0 mass re-certification. Every phase is independently reversible.
guiding_principles: Existing certifications survive transition — no mass re-certification. The 2,181 currently Certified items remain Certified throughout.
Each phase independently reversible — can roll back any phase without losing the other two.
All phases NO-OP in read-only sessions — agents detect 'nothing to do' and return immediately.
Series boundaries respected — Phase closeouts at S330, S340, S350 decision checkpoints.
Every phase includes pre/post metrics comparison gate.

migration_modes.description: Four operational modes describing the relationship between Framework v1 and Framework v2 at each stage of the migration.

mode_1_v1_dominant.label: Framework v1 (Current — Pre-S321)
mode_1_v1_dominant.description: The current operational state. 8 boards, 72 agents cataloged, 15-28 agents per certification wave. 1,227 reports. 89.5% readiness failure. No compound-key identity. No pre-flight gate. No delta review.
mode_1_v1_dominant.exit_criteria: S322 begins Phase 1 implementation. Framework v2 infrastructure artifacts begin being generated in read-only mode alongside v1 operations.

mode_2_hybrid.label: Hybrid Mode — Framework v1 + v2 Infrastructure (S322–S329)
mode_2_hybrid.description: Framework v2 infrastructure artifacts (Registry, Scan Artifact, Delta Ledger, 4 reports) are generated at every session boundary — but Framework v1 boards continue to operate unchanged. v2 artifacts are read-only and advisory. Agents reference v2 data for better decisions but are not required to use it. Governance guard Rules 6-8 are in shadow mode (log, don't block).
active_components: Framework v1: All 8 boards still authoritative
Framework v2: Registry (auto-generated T0/Tend), Scan Pipeline (runs at T0), Delta Engine (T0 classification, advisory only), 4 Reports (generated alongside v1 reports)
v2_artifacts_generated: 4 standard v2 reports (DASHBOARD, SUMMARY, QUALITY_VERDICT, CERTIFICATION_RESULTS)
mode_2_hybrid.v1_integrity: Zero impact on Framework v1 operations. v2 infrastructure operates purely in read-only append mode — it reads pack files, generates artifacts, writes to new report files. No existing workflow is modified.
mode_2_hybrid.decision_checkpoint: S330: Independent audit confirms: (a) Registry compound keys resolve to correct items (0 discrepancies vs. within-object extraction), (b) pre-flight scan pipeline catches all known defect classes with <5% false-positive rate, (c) delta ledger hash stability confirmed across 2+ sessions. If ALL PASS → authorize Phase 2 (mode transition).

mode_3_shadow.label: Shadow Mode — Framework v2 Parallel (S331–S339)
mode_3_shadow.description: Framework v2 boards begin operating in parallel with Framework v1 boards. Quality Board runs 3-agent unified review alongside the 6 existing review boards. Governance Board runs shadow decisions (reads both v1 and v2 outputs, produces decisions, does not block current flow). Certification Board runs governance-sufficiency review (does not overrule v1 Certification Board). Delta review routes items to boards (advisory routing — v1 boards still review all items).
active_components: Framework v1: All 8 boards still authoritative for certification decisions

Framework v2: Quality Board (3 agents, advisory verdict), Governance Board (shadow mode only), Certification Board (governance-sufficiency review, advisory only), Delta Engine (advisory routing, v1 boards override)
mode_3_shadow.validation_gate: Dual-run validation: 3 certification waves where Quality Board runs in parallel with existing boards. Same items, same agents, comparison of findings. Must achieve >95% agreement. If Quality Board misses any DL-008/DL-030 class defect that current boards catch → fix prompts and re-validate.
mode_3_shadow.governance_integration: Governance guard Rules 6-8 go LIVE in WARN mode (log violations, don't block writes). Shadow deployment for 3 waves before rules become authoritative HARD_BLOCK.
mode_3_shadow.decision_checkpoint: S340: Independent audit confirms: (a) Quality Board verdicts match current multi-board verdicts >95%, (b) delta review correctly classifies items (0 false-negative 'no_change' on genuinely changed items), (c) Governance Board shadow decisions match current gates 100%, (d) governance guard Rules 6-8 false-positive rate <5%. If ALL PASS → activate Framework v2 as authoritative.

mode_4_v2_active.label: Framework v2 Active (S341+)
mode_4_v2_active.description: Framework v2 is the authoritative certification architecture. Framework v1 boards are retired. 4-board model is active. Readiness Gate Engine mediates all state transitions. Delta review is authoritative — unchanged items skip review. 4 reports per session. Governance guard Rules 6-8 are HARD_BLOCK.
active_components: Framework v2: Registry Board (auto-generated), Quality Board (3 agents), Governance Board (1 agent, authoritative), Certification Board (1 agent, governance-sufficiency review)
Framework v1: Retired — boards 1-8 deactivated. Legacy reports archived.
transition_actions: Retire Framework v1 boards 1-8 (Technical, DQS, EQS, UIQS, Learner Safety, QA Review, Readiness Review, Launch Board)
Activate Governance guard Rules 6-8 as HARD_BLOCK
Activate session-exclusive file lock protocol (prevent DL-019 concurrent writes)
Enter continuous improvement cycle (Phase 3: metrics tracking, false-positive monitoring, methodology refinement)
mode_4_v2_active.post_transition: S350: Full operational validation across 5 certification waves. Confirm: (a) defect escape rate <1%, (b) FP hash mismatch rate <2%, (c) agents per wave ≤7, (d) reports per session ≤6, (e) 0 items incorrectly classified NO_CHANGE, (f) delivery pool 0 known-defective QIDs.

phase_milestones.description: Concrete milestones tied to the S201 Framework v2 Vision transition phases.

deliverables.description: Build MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md with within-object Function constructor parse. Generate template family map for all 2,500 items. Implement compound key field schema. Validate: certified count matches dual-verified count (0 discrepancy), registry hash stable across 2 passes.

Implement Gate 0 JSON Integrity (parse all packs, field presence, corruption detection). Implement Gate 1 Structural Scan (DL-008, DL-026, DL-016 automated detection). Implement Gate 2 Content Scan (DL-013 boilerplate, EV3 principle citation). Add governance guard Rules 6 and 7.

Implement SHA-256 content hashing on canonical JSON serialization. Generate initial DELTA_LEDGER.json for all 2,500 items. Re-extract and re-hash all 2,500 items via independent second pass — 0 mismatches required. Cross-validate 5% sample with manual field extraction.

closeout_criteria: Registry compound keys resolve to correct items with 0 discrepancy
Pre-flight gate catches all known defect classes with <5% false-positive rate
Delta ledger hash stability confirmed across 2+ independent passes
All v2 artifacts are read-only — 0 certification actions, 0 content modifications, 0 pack-file writes

deliverables.description: Merge Technical + DQS + EQS + Learner Safety (content) + QA (structural) into 3-agent Quality Board. Run 3 dual-run certification waves: Quality Board in parallel with existing boards. Verify agreement >95%. Adjudicate discrepancies. Retire boards 1-6 after 3 successful waves.
deliverables.depends_on: S321 READINESS_ENGINE_SPEC + S201 Quality Board design

deliverables.description: Integrate delta pre-flight into session startup protocol (AGENTS.md §9 updated). Classify items at session T0. Quality Board only reviews items routed to non-skip change types. Dry-run alongside full review on 1 certification wave — compare findings.

deliverables.milestone: P2.3 — Governance Board Shadow Mode + Rules 6-8 Shadow Deployment
deliverables.description: Implement GOV-AUTO-01 through GOV-AUTO-10 automated checks. Run Governance Board in shadow mode for 3 sessions. Validate decisions match current Readiness + Launch board decisions 100%. Deploy governance guard Rules 6-8 in WARN mode.

phase_2_consolidation.closeout_session: S340 — Phase 2 Closeout Audit + Authorization Decision
closeout_criteria: Quality Board verdicts match current multi-board verdicts >95%
Delta review correctly classifies items (0 false-negative NO_CHANGE on genuinely changed items)
Governance Board shadow decisions match current gates 100%

deliverables.description: Merge all dashboard variants into single DASHBOARD.json per session. Eliminate agent-standalone outputs (embed into Quality Board verdict). Standardize file naming to SESSIONXXX_ prefix. Target: ≤4 files per non-certification session, ≤6 per certification session.
Implement Gate 3 Identity Reconciliation + Gate 4 Calculation Validation (full DL-030 Tier 1 + Tier 3 + DL-031).

deliverables.milestone: P3.3 — Certification Board Refocus + Rule 8 + Session Lock Protocol
deliverables.description: Refocus Certification Board to governance-sufficiency review. Add governance guard Rule 8 (Template Boilerplate Prohibition). Implement session-exclusive file lock protocol.

closeout_criteria: Defect escape rate <1% across 5 certification waves
0 items incorrectly classified NO_CHANGE after 3 waves

phase_1_rollback.trigger: Compound key registry has >0 discrepancies vs. within-object extraction, OR pre-flight gate false-positive rate >5%, OR delta ledger hash instability across passes.
phase_1_rollback.action: Disable v2 artifact generation. Framework v1 continues operating unchanged. v2 infrastructure scripts archived. Root cause analysis. Fix methodology. Re-run Phase 1 deliverables.
phase_1_rollback.impact_on_certifications: Zero. No question_state changes during Phase 1. All v2 artifacts were read-only.

phase_2_rollback.trigger: Quality Board agreement rate <95% after 3 dual-run waves with prompt fixes, OR delta review false-negative detected, OR Governance Board shadow decisions diverge from current gates.
phase_2_rollback.action: Deactivate Quality Board, Governance Board, and Delta Review routing. Reinstate all 8 Framework v1 boards as authoritative. Investigate failure mode. Fix methodology. Re-run dual-run validation before re-attempting transition.
phase_2_rollback.impact_on_certifications: Items certified by Framework v1 boards during Phase 2 remain Certified. v2 Quality Board verdicts were advisory only — no certification decisions were made by v2 boards. Rollback: zero impact on certified pool.

phase_3_rollback.trigger: Reporting consolidation loses critical information, OR Gate 3-4 false-positive rate >5%, OR Certification Board governance-sufficiency review misses defects that full re-verification would have caught.
phase_3_rollback.action: Reporting: reinstate tracked metric files as-needed (legacy reports archived, not deleted). Gates 3-4: toggle to WARN-only (do not block certification). Certification Board: roll back to full evidence re-verification.
phase_3_rollback.impact_on_certifications: Items certified under Phase 3 were verified by Quality Board (same CAQS standard). Certification Board methodology change is procedural, not quality-standard. Rollback: re-verify the batch under the old methodology — if any defects found, remediate per standard workflow.

migration_risks.references: SEE SESSION201_FRAMEWORK_V2_VISION.json §migration_risks — MR-01 through MR-06 are the authoritative risk catalog. This plan inherits all 6 risks and their mitigations.

additional_risks.title: S321 specifications are insufficiently detailed for implementation — S322 agents cannot code from specs alone
additional_risks.mitigation: S321 specs are explicitly tagged 'implementable' in their success criteria. Each spec includes: field schemas, algorithms, integration points, performance estimates, and script references. S322 should verify spec-completeness at T0 before beginning implementation.

additional_risks.title: Hybrid mode (S322-S329) creates confusion — agents reference v2 advisory data alongside v1 authoritative data and make conflicting decisions
additional_risks.mitigation: v2 artifacts are clearly labeled as ADVISORY ONLY during Hybrid mode. Governance guard enforces: if v1 and v2 data conflict, v1 is authoritative. v2 data is informational enrichment, not decision override.
